Get the path to the field plan Excel sheet

get_field_plan_path.Rd

This function retrieves the full path to the field plan Excel sheet for a specified year. It searches for the file in the given directory and returns the first match found. If no matching file is found, it raises an error.

Usage

get_field_plan_path(
  field_plan_path = file.path(the$sea_track_folder, "Admin/Fieldplanning"),
  field_year = c(as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")))
)

Arguments

field_plan_path

The directory path where the field plan Excel sheet is located (default is "Admin/Fieldplanning" within the SEATRACK folder)

field_year

The year for which to retrieve the field plan (default is the current year)

Value

The full path to the field plan Excel sheet
